scope: Read-only metadata: public,coach_private,auth,storage; enums/extensions/event triggers/publications across project. No customer records, secrets or function bodies.

views.name: fee_invoice_balances
views.definition:
SELECT i.id,
    i.academy_id,
    i.enrolment_id,
    i.billing_month,
    i.due_on,
    i.amount_paise,
    i.currency,
    i.created_at,
    i.student_name,
    i.batch_name,
    i.created_by,
    i.voided_at,
    i.voided_by,
    i.void_reason,
    COALESCE(p.paid_paise, 0::numeric)::bigint AS paid_paise,
    COALESCE(p.test_paise, 0::numeric)::bigint AS test_paise,
    GREATEST(i.amount_paise::numeric - COALESCE(p.paid_paise, 0::numeric), 0::numeric)::bigint AS balance_paise,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p.paid_paise, 0::numeric) - i.amount_paise::numeric, 0::numeric)::bigint AS excess_paise
   FROM fee_invoices i
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(p_1.amount_paise) FILTER (WHERE p_1.mode = 'live'::text) AS paid_paise,
            sum(p_1.amount_paise) FILTER (WHERE p_1.mode = 'test'::text) AS test_paise
           FROM fee_payments p_1
          WHERE p_1.invoice_id = i.id AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM fee_payment_reversals r
                  WHERE r.payment_id = p_1.id))) p ON true;

views.name: coach_media_consents
views.definition:
SELECT event_id,
    academy_id,
    student_id,
    guardian_name,
    evidence_note,
    allow_photos AND coach_private.consent_identity_current(academy_id, student_id, recorded_by, source) AS allow_photos,
    allow_videos AND coach_private.consent_identity_current(academy_id, student_id, recorded_by, source) AS allow_videos,
    allow_parent_sharing AND coach_private.consent_identity_current(academy_id, student_id, recorded_by, source) AS allow_parent_sharing,
    recorded_by,
    recorded_at,
    source
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (coach_media_consent_events.academy_id, coach_media_consent_events.student_id) coach_media_consent_events.event_id,
            coach_media_consent_events.academy_id,
            coach_media_consent_events.student_id,
            coach_media_consent_events.guardian_name,
            coach_media_consent_events.evidence_note,
            coach_media_consent_events.allow_photos,
            coach_media_consent_events.allow_videos,
            coach_media_consent_events.allow_parent_sharing,
            coach_media_consent_events.recorded_by,
            coach_media_consent_events.recorded_at,
            coach_media_consent_events.source
           FROM coach_media_consent_events
          ORDER BY coach_media_consent_events.academy_id, coach_media_consent_events.student_id, coach_media_consent_events.event_id DESC) c;

views.name: parent_feedback_feed
views.definition:
SELECT h.id,
    l.child_id,
    h.snapshot,
    h.reviewed_at
   FROM parent_feedback_handoffs h
     JOIN parent_coach_links l ON l.academy_id = h.academy_id AND l.student_id = h.student_id
  WHERE l.active AND l.parent_user_id = auth.uid() AND h.state = 'available_to_parent'::text;
